title: Preallocate Fusion merge heaps
scope: Fusion compaction and visible-range heap allocation

summary: Added a merge_heap helper that constructs BinaryHeap with caller-provided capacity.
Changed compaction merge heap initialization to reserve one slot per candidate SSTable iterator.
Changed visible-range merge heap initialization to reserve for the write-buffer iterator, memtable iterators, and SSTable iterators.
Moved the visible-range SSTable snapshot before heap creation so the heap capacity uses the same snapshot that later creates SSTable iterators.

Keep each optimization behavior-equivalent and commit it with its own .workflow/.csv-wave evidence.
